actions.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources Subcommittee on National Parks. Hearings held. With printed Hearing: S.Hrg. 119-238.
Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 362 - 50, 2 Present (Roll no. 124). (text: CR H1979)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 362 - 50, 2 Present (Roll no. 124). (text: CR H1979)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H1986-1987)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 249.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H1979-1980)
Mr. Westerman moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 39.
Reported by the Committee on Natural Resources. H. Rept. 119-62.
Reported by the Committee on Natural Resources. H. Rept. 119-62.
Ordered to be Reported by Unanimous Consent.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Natural Resources.

dimensions.assessment: Affects visitors and local records of the Paterson Great Falls National Historical Park.
dimensions.evidence: Great Falls Scenic Overlook Trail Bridge at Paterson Great Falls National Historical Park shall hereafter be known and designated as 'Bill Pascrell, Jr. Scenic Overlook Trail Bridge'

dimensions.assessment: Purely ceremonial renaming of existing park facilities.
dimensions.evidence: To redesignate certain facilities at Paterson Great Falls National Historical Park in honor of Congressman Bill Pascrell, Jr.

dimensions.assessment: No fiscal implications, federal spending, or revenue changes are stated.
Limited strictly to the naming designation of two specific park features.
dimensions.evidence: Overlook Park at Paterson Great Falls National Historical Park shall hereafter be known and designated as 'Bill Pascrell, Jr. Overlook Park'

dimensions.assessment: Permanent name change for the specified federal park facilities.
